facebook.content:
Hey friends, 

I want to invite you to a place of joy, where the presence of God is palpable, and the atmosphere is charged with His love. Join us for IFM worship gatherings – monthly in-person at 24301 Telegraph in Southfield, MI on the First Saturday of every month at 12 Noon.

Or, if you can't make it in-person, join us online daily for the Hour of Power on Facebook Live, Monday through Friday at 8:15 AM.
